path.description: Local path or URL of a JSON array of trips. Each trip has path and timestamps.

data.description: Inline trips. Used when path is empty.

useProxy.description: Route requests through the Jupyter server proxy to avoid CORS issues.

httpHeaders.description: HTTP headers forwarded to the upstream server when useProxy is true.

trip.title: ITrip
trip.description: One animated path. path and timestamps are the same length, in visit order.

path.description: Positions as [longitude, latitude] or [longitude, latitude, altitude], in visit order.

timestamps.description: Time each path position is visited. Same units as TripsLayer trailLength. Not a unix timestamp; float32 cannot hold raw unix milliseconds.
